Cruise ship grounding.requires: a passenger vessel on an uncharted shoal
Cruise ship grounding.provides: hundreds of untrained survivors, the hull initially intact, days of shelter aboard

Fishing vessel capsize.provides: a handful of crew, immediate immersion, no shelter aboard at all

Aircraft ditching offshore.requires: an aircraft forced onto the water
Aircraft ditching offshore.provides: survivors dispersed on the surface, minutes of survival time, a known last position

Ice-trapped cargo vessel.requires: a hull beset in moving pack ice
Ice-trapped cargo vessel.provides: no immediate life risk, indefinite immobility, crew safe aboard

Long-range maritime patrol aircraft.requires: an airfield within range and flyable weather
Long-range maritime patrol aircraft.provides: rapid arrival and search capability, delivery of supplies only, no recovery of anyone

Helicopter from a shore base.requires: a base within radius of action
Helicopter from a shore base.provides: recovery of small numbers, limited by range and by icing

Icebreaker on task.requires: a vessel already in the region
Icebreaker on task.provides: recovery of large numbers and ice transit, days of steaming to arrive

Vessel of opportunity.requires: another ship close enough to divert
Vessel of opportunity.provides: immediate assistance, untrained crew and no ice capability

Open water in summer.requires: an ice-free sea and long daylight
Open water in summer.provides: conventional operations, survivable immersion for a short period

Marginal ice zone.provides: hazard to any conventional hull, aircraft operations unaffected

Polar night.provides: no visual search whatsoever, extreme cold

Blizzard conditions.provides: no flying of any kind, surface search severely degraded

All recovered alive.requires: assistance reaching survivors within survival time

Search suspended without recovery.requires: conditions or endurance defeating the search
